$comment: Objective goals for the self-iterating improvement loop. A goal is MET only when its visual probe (deterministic DOM/render state at screenshot time) AND its logic check (deterministic window.__game assertion) both pass. The AI vision pass (analyze.mjs) is advisory: it reads the saved PNGs to flag regressions the probes can't express and to prioritise the next improvement. 'beat' refers to a capture step in capture.mjs. 'probe' is a JS expression evaluated in the page (g = window.__game) returning a boolean.

goals.title: Title screen is legible and actionable
goals.description: On load the player sees the game title and a clear way to start.

visual.criteria: #title screen visible, H1 reads DEAD AIR, DESCEND button visible

goals.title: Descent cutscene presents cinematically
goals.description: The opening cutscene shows letterbox bars and a dialogue caption, with the skip hint.

visual.criteria: #letterbox has .on, a caption is showing, skip hint visible

goals.title: Core gameplay HUD is present
goals.description: During normal play the objective line, compass, crosshair and battery meter are all on screen.

goals.title: Wayfinding points to the objective
goals.description: While an objective is active the wayfinder shows an on-screen marker or an off-screen edge arrow with its label, and the compass pip is positioned.

visual.criteria: objective marker or edge arrow shown with a non-empty label; compass pip present

goals.title: Restoring power visibly lights the station
goals.description: After refitting both fuses, main power flips on: the generator light is lit, the breaker panel LED goes green, and the service stair unlocks.

visual.criteria: generator room light on, panel LED green-ish

logic.criteria: power=true, stair unlocked, no premature chase/broadcast

goals.title: Intake archive reads as the revelation beat
goals.description: The sub-level archive (the wall of faces / ledger) is reachable and presented; the archive cutscene fires on entry.

visual.criteria: player is inside the intake hall under its (failing grey-green) lighting; archive scene visible

goals.title: Final chase has clear danger feedback
goals.description: When the broadcast is re-armed the final chase starts: the chase vignette turns on, emergency lights pulse, and wayfinding is hidden (you already know: out).

visual.criteria: #chase-vignette has .on, wayfinder hidden, emergency concourse light on

logic.criteria: broadcast=true, final chase started, emergency lights on

goals.title: Death resolves to the count-holds screen
goals.description: Contact with the Tallyman triggers the kill-cam then the death screen, and any open note is dismissed.

visual.criteria: #dead screen visible with THE COUNT HOLDS and a CONTINUE/QUIT choice

logic.criteria: death screen shows on contact, note dismissed

goals.title: Escape resolves to the surface screen
goals.description: Opening the hatch after re-arming the broadcast plays the escape cutscene and shows the SURFACE win screen.

goals.title: The sub-level reads as sickly grey-green
goals.description: DESIGN.md gives each zone an identity colour and the sub-level is 'sickly grey-green, failing'. The intake archive lights are already grey-green but the repeater-core light is warm amber, breaking the palette. Every active sub-level room light should be green-dominant so the revelation floor reads as oppressive, not cosy.

visual.criteria: repeater-core lighting is grey-green (green-dominant), not warm amber

logic.criteria: every sub-level room light (intake A/B, core, pump) is green-dominant and lit

goals.title: Checkpoint toast never overlaps a cutscene
goals.description: The '✓ checkpoint' toast must not be shown while a cinematic / letterbox is active — it overlaps the cinematic frame mid-reveal. Toasts should be suppressed (or deferred) whenever the letterbox is on.

logic.criteria: calling toast() while the letterbox is on does not display it

goals.title: The level is fully traversable and correctly gated
goals.description: Every key route is walkable and the service stair is blocked until power is restored.

logic.criteria: all key routes walkable; stair locked pre-power

goals.title: Fuse pickups advance the act and wake the threat
goals.description: Collecting the two breaker fuses increments the counter and rouses the Tallyman from dormant.

logic.criteria: fuse A then B increments; stalker leaves dormant

goals.title: Fire doors buy time, then break
goals.description: A slammed fire door delays the Tallyman during the chase, then it bashes through.

logic.criteria: stalker breaks a closed fire door in chase

goals.title: Checkpoints save, restore and clear safely
goals.description: Progress checkpoints to localStorage, CONTINUE restores it in-place, and NEW GAME clears it.
